test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0d0a96fa43e138c719663d5f63cc8ab1e3fe7ba9175b24e83a2d25238eed784.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The figures rotate in clockwise direction in the form of a triad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d6a8931ff7c64de20a7e9441bf5f85b241407a080a53bc8264f2a53d0623877.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b8a33b475144d6b498ec993e2fd3f903b48b9e7fc130205aefe3084c6ceb653.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/614e3fb1cee3bd99b2294ac8a280e322a06e0d875f6e014f895dc7b6cc6fb3cc.png] 

Next step:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/651af9bae927004f181289827eb6071467bfd8a4a3f824d48c5a1f22279557fc.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13e525a669a955511ce7f9cb434d7626221cb4197e2cf2891b31c02a93bbfd4c.png] The head of arrow is in opposite direction.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a31bca0b3a4f5238a4552237301fc29d2fe954944811cb7b797601108cad48c.png] Positioning of star and triangle is incorrect.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/651af9bae927004f181289827eb6071467bfd8a4a3f824d48c5a1f22279557fc.png] The pattern is correct.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5f568546cdaf6cbd5cb8ad47a9f202f8dcb44a0a4449586a67321f8e7e97f84.png] The positioning of triangle is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
